findings.evidence: `fetch_scoreboards` lines 281–337 performs the canonical-metadata and trusted-login filtering, and metrics line 881 defines `review` as one qualifying `<!--tauceti-scoreboard-->` comment; the naming convention requires names to describe their actual conclusion in standard/source terminology.
findings.fix: Retain the established scoped term, e.g. “Canonical v1 review scoreboards by contributor,” throughout the chart title, subtitle, alt text, caption, and prose.
findings.issue: “Reviews by contributor” and noun “reviews” misleadingly suggest all PR reviews, but the series counts only canonical v1 scoreboard comments whose authors also have a merged PR; the same overbroad wording appears in `web/Site/Stats.lean` lines 84, 87, 145, and 148.

summary: The shortened “reviews” terminology overstates a narrowly filtered count of canonical scoreboard comments and conflicts with the source API’s established “scoreboard” term.
